diameterInterpretation: Approximate scale from a thermal diameter of 61.4 ± 12.7 km. Quoted uncertainty does not fully include thermal-model and viewing-geometry effects.

calibration.reference: Licandro et al. (2016), A&A 585, A9, Table 3
calibration.notes: WISE W3 and W4: 5 measurements in each band, observed at heliocentric distance 9.067 au, observer distance 9.014 au and phaseangle 6.262 deg (Table 2); beamingparameter 0.90±0.24 was fitted.
calibration.basis: effective spherical radiometric diameter applied as approximate volume-equivalent size
calibration.assumption: Uniformly scale the independently inferred convex shape to the reported effective thermal diameter. This does not establish a measured volume or shape-matched thermophysical calibration; quoted catalog errors exclude shape/orientation and survey systematic uncertainty.
calibration.sourceLabel: Licandro et al. (2016), A&A 585, A9, Table 3
calibration.limitations: Uniformly scale the independently inferred convex shape to the reported effective thermal diameter. modelLimitations: The convex inversion resolves the broad shape; craters and concavities are unresolved.
